build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/tap/Cargo.toml && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/tap/Cargo.toml

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://api.open-meteo.com https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

bundle.longDescription: Nightmoth themes Windows around your wallpaper and keeps your PC fast from the system tray.
